reference_set.privacy_note: Reference images are intentionally not bundled; approved source images may contain real people and student evidence.

palette_role_note: Measured medians from the 14-slide raster reference set; use as visual anchors, not immutable brand tokens.
layout_grammar: deep royal-blue title plaque with gold bevel/outline
cream-white content cards with gold framing
bright school-campus/daylight background when contextually appropriate
real portrait or evidence photo as a large anchor
gold-framed photo collage with diagonal/polygon variations
circular medallion icons with gold rim
navy body text with limited blue, green, magenta, orange KPI accents
bottom footer system with school/office identity, fiscal-year pill, and blue page-number wedge
evidence_rules: Use canonical real school logo when logo is required.
Do not fabricate activity photos, certificates, statistics, or people as evidence.
Keep decorative generated visuals distinguishable from evidence.
Prefer replaceable photo regions and clean gutters between semantic regions.

production_target_when_magic_layers_is_r.note: Target is from the validated Magic Layers workflow and must be verified after export/upscale.
